corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request, Depends, HTTPException
import pycrdt as yjs

router = APIRouter(prefix="/crdt/delta")

@router.post("/documents/{doc_id}/apply-update")
async def apply_offline_crdt_patch(
    doc_id: str,
    request: Request,
    doc_store: YjsDocStore = Depends(get_crdt_doc_store),
    perm_service: PermissionService = Depends(get_permission_service),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    if not await perm_service.can_edit_document(current_user.id, doc_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: Insufficient permissions to update this document")

    patch_bytes = await request.body()
    if not patch_bytes:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Empty update payload")

    ydoc = await doc_store.get(doc_id)
    if not ydoc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Document does not exist")

    yjs.apply_update(ydoc, patch_bytes)
    await doc_store.save(doc_id, ydoc)
    return {"status": "update_applied", "doc_id": doc_id, "bytes_applied": len(patch_bytes)}
